title: Father's racehorse fixing overheard as a child
place_text: Lazar family home (Long Island, New York)

tellings.quote: playing in the living room and hearing those guys deciding who's going to win the race

plain: Bob Lazar, a man known for saying he worked on secret craft for the US government, says that as a small boy in the early 1970s, at the family home on Long Island, New York, he played in the living room while his father and other men decided who would win a horse race. He tells it to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, as a memory of a childhood near rigged racing, which would say something about the world he grew up in if true.
